integrity.note: extracted into a session scratch directory only; the host was not modified

bws_provider_works_live.detail: bws://<project> resolved the declared secret against the real project

bootstrap_with_current_keyring_model.detail: the BWS provider accepts BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN from the environment, so the existing keyring bootstrap feeds it unchanged; no keyring entry migration and no secretspec config provider login were required

only_declared_secrets_resolved.detail: an undeclared key present in a synthetic dotenv source was not exported; the live export returned exactly TYPESAFE_API_KEY

declarative_declarations.detail: secretspec.toml profiles with required flags and descriptions

explicit_operator_materialization.detail: export is a separate command; nothing requires it at process start

export_feeds_atomic_activation.detail: secretspec export -> Blaine validate -> Blaine atomic 0600 activation produced a credential identical to the current one

runtime_offline_after_materialization.detail: unchanged; the runtime boundary reads only the local credential and never invokes secretspec

fail_closed_during_materialization.detail: an absent bootstrap token produced no partial export and left the existing credential untouched

no_value_in_evidence.detail: only value length and a sha256 prefix were recorded

notable_behaviour.agent_access_policy: require_reason defaults to "agents": an agent-run resolution is refused unless it supplies --reason, which is recorded
notable_behaviour.export_format: shell export KEY='value' lines, parseable but not dotenv
notable_behaviour.rejected_model: service startup -> secretspec -> BWS -> service remains rejected and was never tested as an adoption candidate
